source_title: Sara Ali Khan's net worth grows from Rs 13 crore to Rs 41 crore
source_excerpt: Sara Ali Khan has witnessed a considerable rise in her film career since making her Bollywood debut in 2018. Alongside her acting assignments, the actress has built a financial portfolio through brand endorsements, social media collaborations and reported real estate investments. Her assets also include premium automobiles, reflecting her growing presence in the entertainment industry.According to India Times, Sara Ali Khan's estimated net worth currently stands at around Rs 41 crore. Her wealth has reportedly grown alongside her expanding filmography and commercial associations. The actress has also explored opportunities beyond the big screen, adding different revenue streams to her earnings.Sara Ali Khan's net worthThe estimated worth of Sara Ali Khan's assets was Rs 13 crore in 2019. However, this number has grown significantly to around Rs 20 crore in 2021 and has now reached an estimated Rs 24 crore in 2025. The latest estimate places her net worth at approximately Rs 41 crore.How much does Sara Ali Khan charge for films?Films remain one of the primary sources of income for the actress. According to Asianet reports, she charges approximately Rs 3 crore for a movie. Over the years, she has worked across different genres and appeared in theatrical as well as streaming releases.Her growing visibility has helped her secure several commercial opportunities. Film projects continue to form an important part of her professional portfolio, while endorsements provide an additional source of income. Brand partnerships contribute significantly to Sara's reported earnings. According to information cited by Asianet, the actress charges around Rs 1 crore for an endorsement deal. She has collaborated with several commercial brands, making advertising an important part of her financial portfolio.Social media has opened up another avenue for the actress. Her online popularity allows her to participate in sponsored posts and digital campaigns.'Udta Teer' adds to Sara Ali Khan's recent film projectsOn the professional front, Sara Ali Khan recently appeared in 'Udta Teer', alongside Ayushmann Khurrana. The spy comedy has completed eight days in theatres and entered its second week with an improvement in box office collections.According to the Sacnilk-reported figures, the film has accumulated Rs 50.03 crore in worldwide gross collections. Its Day 8 domestic earnings increased by 26.7% compared with the previous day. This came after a series of daily declines, offering the film some relief at the box office.Sara Ali Khan's car collectionSara also has a collection of premium SUVs. The vehicles associated with her include a Mercedes-Benz G-Class G 350d and a Jeep Compass.
